text:
maria: Heads up — Pagerflow alerts show a bunch of failed deliveries since ~09:12 UTC. Incident-bot created an incident but oncall says they didn't receive pages. :thinking_face:

incident-bot: Incident 2025-07-18T09:14 created for notify-relay (delivery_failures). Tried paging oncall(sre_oncall) but no ACK received. Logs: `500` from `relay-proxy` when forwarding to `notify-relay`

jonathan: seeing a spike of `sig_mismatch` errors in notify-relay auth checks around the same time. Example from logs: `incoming signature header split into 2 values` and `computed_sig != header_sig`

sre_oncall: I didn't get the SMS or phone page. Slack DM correlation: incident-bot shows page sent at 09:14 but carrier attempt logs show nothing for the oncall number.

sean: rolling logs on the edge proxy show a config push at 09:10 — enabled `http2_upgrade` + `header_concat = false` (default was true). That could split comma-separated headers into multiple header entries.

maria: that rings true — our pager auth expects a single `X-Pager-Signature` header and computes HMAC over canonicalized header string. If the proxy splits the header, the verification fails and relay rejects the request without retrying.

jonathan: quick check: `curl -v -H "X-Pager-Signature: abc,def" ...` vs `curl -v -H "X-Pager-Signature: abc" -H "X-Pager-Signature: def" ...` — proxy is rewriting to the second form.

ops_bot: Deploy audit: proxy config change deployed at 09:09 by `proxy-ci` (change-id ch_2025-07-18-0910).

sean: mitigation plan: 1) revert proxy header handling to `header_concat=true` 2) enable fallback routing in notify-relay to accept multi-header signatures for 30m 3) send manual pages for any missed incidents.

maria: I'm rolling the revert now. Command: ```kubectl apply -f proxy-config-revert.yaml --record```

jonathan: while that goes, patch notify-relay to accept multi-header signatures: small check to join `request.headers.get_all('X-Pager-Signature')` before validation. I'll push a hotfix branch.

incident-bot: NOTE — automatic retry policy suppressed for 429/5xx responses where auth fails. We'll temporarily flip `auto_retry_on_auth_fail=true` to trigger retries for current active incidents.

sean: proxy revert complete at 09:25. Edge shows single header again. Notifying notify-relay to reprocess backlog.

maria: requeued the last 30m of messages to notify-relay. Commands I ran: ```./tools/relay-replay --since 09:00 --service notify-relay```

sre_oncall: received manual phone pages now at 09:28. Confirmed two customers reported missed alerting in that window; support ticket numbers: #4621, #4624.

jonathan: hotfix merged and deployed (notify-relay accepts multi-header signatures) at 09:33. That gives compatibility while we verify proxy behavior.

incident-bot: paging health check passing now — last delivery attempts successful. Marks incident as mitigated for live customer impact, continuing to monitor.

maria: customer impact summary: approx 8 routed pages failed to reach carriers between 09:12–09:28. Two customers opened support tickets and one oncall escalated manually. No long-lived customer outages (no missed SLOs yet) but this is a near-miss.

sean: root cause: proxy header normalization change in config push (http2 muxing + header concat disabled) that turned single comma-separated header into multiple headers. Signature validation expected concatenated header.

jonathan: postmortem action items (owners):
- add header-splitting test to proxy CI (owner: se an)
- make notify-relay signature validator tolerant to multi-header forms (owner: jonathan) [done as hotfix]
- update deploy checklist to include paging integration smoke test (owner: maria)
- add `auto_retry_on_auth_fail` guard with alerting if enabled for >5m (owner: ops)

maria: opening a postmortem doc and pinging compliance for customer notification template. I'll assign owners and target a write-up by EOD.

sre_oncall: adding retrospective note — treat any proxy header handling change as high-risk for downstream auth.

sean: logs and relevant config diffs pushed to the incident GCS folder: `gs://redwood-incidents/1758209999/`

jonathan: small follow-up: check other headers used by downstream services (`X-Notify-ID`, `X-Pager-Auth`) for similar split-handling. I'll run a grep across services.

maria: thanks all. Marking the thread resolved for live routing. We'll keep monitoring for 24h and then close after postmortem. :white_check_mark:
